subject: Commercial onramp: procurement options & security gating
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@medhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 17:25:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial onramp: procurement options & security gating

Hi Morgan — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we’re aligned as you evaluate Redwood for the MedHealth pilot.

Call highlights
- Primary use: clinical documentation assistant for a 3-team pilot (PII/no PHI expected in prompts, but logs will be retained briefly for observability).
- Commercial preference: Alice mentioned preference for marketplace procurement if possible, otherwise PO via AP.
- Security gating: SOC 2 Type II report and a signed DPA are required before vendor onboarding. You also have a short security questionnaire we should return.

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll attach the redacted SOC 2 report and our standard DPA for review (see attachments).
2) Marissa / Rafael to confirm commercial options: marketplace listing availability + PO terms (net30 typical, do we accept corporate cards for pilots?).
3) Morgan / Alice to share any vendor onboarding checklist / security questionnaire items we should prioritize.
4) Schedule a 30-min commercial + security sync next week to close paper process and timelines.

Notes / asks for MedHealth
- Please confirm whether the pilot team can onboard via AWS Marketplace procurement or if AP requires a vendor setup + PO.
- If PO: who is the AP contact and do you have a sample PO template we should expect?

Attachments: redwood_soc2_redacted.pdf (redacted), redwood_standard_dpa_v1.2.pdf (DPA).

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@medhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@medhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Commercial onramp: procurement options & security gating

Jordan — appreciated the recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Marketplace preference: Yes, our procurement team prefers AWS Marketplace purchases where possible because it speeds our vendor onboarding and avoids new vendor setup. That said, the paper team can accept a PO if marketplace isn’t available.
- Security gating: We need a SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK), our standard DPA (we’ll review), and completion of the attached vendor security questionnaire (I’ll send it separately).
- Card vs PO: For pilots under $10k we sometimes use corporate card, but anything above that must go through AP with a PO.

Please confirm whether you’re already live on AWS Marketplace and share a marketplace listing link. Also send a short answers doc for the security questionnaire — I can triage high-risk answers for our InfoSec.

I’ll loop in procurement (Alice) for timelines — Alice, can you confirm whether MedHealth can commit to a pilot budget this quarter and expected PO lead time?

Thanks,
Morgan
Head of Clinical Ops | MedHealth
morgan.lee@medhealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Commercial onramp: procurement options & security gating

Marissa / Rafael — forwarding Morgan’s reply. Two immediate asks we should handle before the commercial sync: 

1) Marketplace status & listing URL — if we can confirm AWS Marketplace procurement is available for MedHealth, that removes vendor setup friction. Rafael, is the AMZN listing live and can we provide the listing PDF?
2) Pricing & paper options — Marissa, please confirm: pilot pricing for 3 teams (est. $8–12k/mo) and whether we can accept corporate card for an initial 30-day trial under $10k; if >$10k, we need PO/net30. Also confirm standard PO terms and lead time.

If we can turn around the SOC2 + DPA today (I attached earlier), I’ll send official answers back to Morgan and ask for their questionnaire so we can prioritize.

Onwards —
Jordan

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@medhealth.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@medhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial onramp: procurement options & security gating

Hi Morgan / Alice — quick update and concrete next steps: 

1) Marketplace: We are listed on AWS Marketplace. Attached is a short listing PDF (marketplace_listing_amzn_2026.pdf) and here’s the public link: https://marketplace.aws.amazon.com/listing/redwood-inference-2026. If MedHealth buys via marketplace we can provision access within 24 hours after purchase.

2) SOC 2 & DPA: Attached is a redacted SOC 2 Type II and our standard DPA (redwood_standard_dpa_v1.2.pdf). We are happy to sign your DPA redline; Rafael can coordinate any minor changes. 

3) Card vs PO: Marissa confirms pilot under $10k can be handled by corporate card for fast start; if the total commitment exceeds $10k, AP requires a PO (typical net30). Rafael notes we can accept PO and invoice on net30 and we can expedite vendor setup if PoC approved.

4) Security questionnaire: Jordan — please send your vendor questionnaire to security@redwood.ai (cc Marissa). We’ll produce a prioritized answers doc within 48 business hours.

Proposed immediate next steps (action owners)
- Morgan / Alice: share vendor security questionnaire and confirm pilot budget window (Action: Morgan)
- Jordan: share access to SOC2 + DPA (Done) and send questionnaire to security@redwood.ai when received (Action: Jordan)
- Rafael: confirm marketplace listing and provide commerce contact for AP (Action: Rafael)
- Marissa: prepare short pilot quote with two options (card pilot under $10k; PO with net30 if above).

If that all looks good, I suggest a 30-min sync on Thursday 10/22 to close paper and confirm start date. Available slots: 10:00am PT or 2:00pm PT.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: marketplace_listing_amzn_2026.pdf, redwood_soc2_redacted.pdf, redwood_standard_dpa_v1.2.pdf
